# Open Props 1.7.23

MIT, Adam Argyle. https://open-props.style/

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/open-props/-/open-props-1.7.23.tgz

Tarball integrity (SHA-512): +xyrJmxV9QUBFbSwPROYhOg/FLXry+uuPr4R+B5EaE4556Oc18/8ZC/fL5A+/lbRSwNvA0Alh+C0KpyFWLmLZg==

`tokens.css` combines sizes.min.css, shadows.dark.min.css, borders.min.css, easings.min.css, durations.min.css, fonts.min.css, colors.min.css; the upstream `:where(html)` selectors are scoped to `:where(.budget-page)` so other screens retain their styles. No reset or component styles are included. The dashboard generator embeds these tokens locally; there is no CDN or network dependency in the browser.
